limits: OS apt packages are recorded in evidence/toolchain-packages.txt, not snapshot-pinned. Exact compiler image and executable hashes identify the qualified local toolchain. A future fresh image build must independently qualify compiler bytes and map outputs.
Upstream compiler source emits one pre-existing enum comparison warning in common/bspinfo.cc:732. All three map qbsp/vis/light passes are warning/error/leak-free.
Compiler binaries and third-party dependencies are build-only; not shipped in map runtime ZIP.

Cross-CPU RGB lighting bytes are not universally identical, including across native Ubuntu24.04 CI hosts. The checked-in first-party CC0 canonical runtime is the release authority, not newly regenerated lighting variants. Each job must compile twice identically and match the canonical BSP header and every byte outside RGB lighting.

ci_source_build.source: same compiler commit/submodules and SHA256-verified Embree/oneTBB archives
ci_source_build.host_tools: preinstalled CMake/Ninja/C++; exact versions and compiler SHA256 recorded in CI artifact evidence/ci-toolchain.json
ci_source_build.offline: sudo unshare --net for configure, source build and both map compiles
ci_source_build.acceptance: two clean source-build output directories byte-identical within job; BSP header and all14 non-lighting lumps/every byte outside RGB identical to canonical; full static/hull/navigation and16 tests; immutable checked-in canonical4-file runtime packaged with exact ZIP/per-file SHA256+SHA512; RGB rebuild deltas quantified, never substituted into release
